# coordination_tool

> Coordinate access to a shared, singular resource so agents don't step on each other (e.g.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `coordination` |
| Callable | MCP clients; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=coordination_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Coordinate access to a shared, singular resource so agents don't step on
each other (e.g. the one DEV/PROD environment).

Actions:
- `claim`   — try to take resource_key. Returns ACQUIRED (you hold it) or
              HELD (someone else has it — who + since when). Re-claiming a
              key you already hold refreshes it (re-entrant, safe).
- `release` — give up a key you hold (by resource_key). Always do this when
              your downstream action is confirmed done.
- `status`  — list what's currently claimed (all keys, or one resource_key).

WHEN to claim: only before an action whose downstream effect — directly or
via a CI trigger — lands on a shared, singular resource (taking the one DEV/
PROD box; a merge that auto-triggers a deploy). Do NOT claim for worktree
build work, opening an MR, or a plain merge — those are already isolated/
serialised. Whether an action has that reach is a RUNBOOK fact.

For a claim that wraps a CI deploy, hold the lease across the pipeline
(heartbeats keep it alive) and release after it verifies. Pass a ttl_minutes
long enough to cover the whole operation; a crashed holder is auto-reclaimed
after the TTL so nothing wedges forever.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes | claim \| release \| status. One of: `claim`, `release`, `status`. |
| `resource_key` | string | no | Opaque key for the contended resource, e.g. "env:dev", "env:prod", "pipeline:model_api:deploy-dev". Required for claim/release. |
| `ttl_minutes` | integer | no | claim only: how long the claim is valid before auto-reclaim (default 30). Set this to comfortably exceed your operation. |
| `note` | string | no | claim only: short human-readable description of what you are doing. |
| `pipeline_ref` | string | no | claim only: the CI pipeline id/url this claim wraps, if any. |
| `reason` | string | no | release only: optional reason, for the audit trail. |
| `orchestration_execution_id` | integer | no | claim only: bind the lease to your orchestration run (enables liveness reclaim). |
| `orchestration_stage_execution_id` | integer | no | claim only: bind the lease to your stage (enables liveness reclaim). |
| `agent_session_id` | integer | no | claim only: bind the lease to your session (enables liveness reclaim). |
